title: Merge Labs and Butterfly Network Partner to Advance Ultrasound-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
summary: BURLINGTON, Mass. & NEW YORK, September 01, 2026--Butterfly Network, Inc. ("Butterfly") (NYSE: BFLY), a pioneer and leader in semiconductor-based ultrasound, programmable cloud software and AI, and Merge Labs today announced a multi-year licensing agreement through Butterfly Embedded™. The agreement gives Merge access to Butterfly’s Poseidon Family of Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology for the development of ultrasound-based brain-computer interfaces (BCI).
